question: Six material-colour pair alternatives, with corrected Practice composition and fixed scenes.

m1.label: Emerald / ivory
m1.direction: Deep emerald green cloth, canopy and enamel are the dominant chromatic areas. Warm ivory trim, stone-lit edges and food highlights provide a clearly separate lighter accent. Near-black forest-green and neutral grey stone shadows. No copper orange, turquoise or gold colour wash.

m2.label: Ochre / aubergine
m2.direction: Strong saffron / ochre yellow cloth, canopy and enamel provide the primary colour identity, with deep aubergine-purple trim, bands and secondary cloth. Ivory food and neutral stone remain natural. Near-black plum shadows. Golden yellow is a matte local pigment, not an all-over golden glow. No blue, green or orange wash.

m3.label: Burnt orange / indigo
m3.direction: Strong burnt-orange cloth, canopy and enamel are the primary colour identity, with clearly separate deep indigo-blue trim and bands. This is orange, not Warrior scarlet-red. Bone highlights and neutral warm-grey stone stay natural. Near-black navy shadows. No green, teal or gold wash.

p1.label: Violet / bone
p1.direction: Strong rich imperial violet robes and drapes establish the primary colour identity. Opaque bone-white collar, cuffs, cloth trim and pale stone-lit edges supply a crisp separate accent. Neutral grey limestone and near-black plum shadows. No pink, magenta sky, glowing purple fog or golden illumination.

p2.label: Ivory / oxblood
p2.direction: Large warm ivory vestments, drapes and pale limestone establish the primary identity; dark oxblood-red collars, cuffs, cloth bands and enamel panels provide a strong separate accent. Faces remain black voids; ash-charcoal shadows create large dark-to-light shapes. This is mostly ivory, not Warrior red. No purple, pink, gold wash or red sky.

p3.label: Wine / mint
p3.direction: Deep wine / mulberry-magenta robes and drapes establish the primary identity, with crisp pale desaturated mint-green trim, collar and small enamel panels as a separate cool accent. This is a dark wine pigment, not pink lighting. Neutral grey limestone, ash-white material highlights and near-black wine shadows. No pink sky, neon, pastel rainbow or gold wash.

entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Medieval dark-fantasy game card illustration, opaque full bleed. Narrative composition in the spirit of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action or building, grouped figures, bold silhouettes, environmental scale, broad calm value masses, and one focused light/contrast area. Hand-placed pixel clusters, hard edges, selective dithering, restricted palette matching the attached l5/l6 surface references ONLY; do not inherit their portal, eye, scenes or writing. All living, dead and depicted faces must be completely indiscernible even at full image size: people from behind, sealed helmets or deep hood voids; no eyes, noses or mouths. Bodies fully shrouded, no skull faces; simple headless ribcages allowed. Non-graphic rot, despair and institutional oppression. No exposed wounds. Clear at70x100 pixels. Illustration only: no text, writing, symbols, UI, frames, decorative borders, vignette, no distracting tiny clutter. STRICT COMPOSITION: 5:7 portrait. Camera pulled back: architecture is much larger than people. Exactly two principal anonymous figures, each only about 16% of image height, stand on a small high service balcony centred at x35-65%, y15-42%. Their complete silhouettes, hands, identifying materials and the ENTIRE decisive action must fit within upper central45% of image height (nothing important below45%). The middle and lower 50% are a broad uninterrupted shadowed stone retaining wall with a few large soft masonry planes: quiet, dark, low contrast, no characters, no stairs, no rubble heap, no bright drapery, no water reflections, no candles or body piles there. Only the upper central area is bright and detailed. No huge foreground figure or portrait. Figure groups subordinate to environmental scale. Subject: Conspicuous Feasts. On that high balcony two back-facing hooded oligarchs deliberately tip a small platter of recognisable food into a sealed refuse chute instead of opening a locked food hatch. The platter, hands, hatch and pouring food are all centred at y28-40%. A short barred hatch and TWO small fully wrapped adult funeral bundles lie on that same upper ledge behind the rail at y38-44%, implying the hungry dead. No extra foreground figures; the corrupt administration keeps functioning. Frayed ceremonial canopy in primary colour high above, black mould on supporting masonry. Keep the architectural upper focal scene compact. Apply primary and accent as TWO SEPARATE LOCAL MATERIAL COLOURS (robes, large cloth, enamel, trim). Broad neutral stone and near-black value masses remain. Neutral cold overcast light. Do NOT apply a monochrome image tint, coloured fog, coloured sky, or high-saturation bounce light to the entire scene. Strong restricted colour identity like the inspected red/teal Warrior and blue/gold Scholar art, with intentional value contrast.Deep emerald green cloth, canopy and enamel are the dominant chromatic areas. Warm ivory trim, stone-lit edges and food highlights provide a clearly separate lighter accent. Near-black forest-green and neutral grey stone shadows. No copper orange, turquoise or gold colour wash.
